what_this_is: A provider description for tools/start-a-computer and tools/move-the-public-door: DNS records at Namecheap, reached through the engine's own call of Namecheap's MCP server (transport "engine"). Each request names one MCP tool in its body_template as { name, arguments }; the DNS client sends it as the engine's tools:run of <host>/<name> at `base`, and reads the tool's structured result. No credential is held for this provider: the engine signs in to the person's Namecheap connection and refreshes it. The legacy REST setHosts call is not used: it replaces the whole zone.
name: Namecheap DNS (MCP)

find_zone.notes: The one domain of the account with this exact name, or none (items []). Reads only.

list_records.notes: The DNS records of one domain, a page at a time. Reads only.

create_record.notes: Point one name at the address, as one A record with the shortest TTL the provider takes.

remove_record.notes: Remove one record, matched by its type, name and address (the provider keeps no ids).
